name: data-database-unit-of-work-runtime

source.content: Database.UnitOfWork uow = new Database.UnitOfWork(); Account inserted = new Account(Name='UOW Insert'); Database.SaveResult insertResult = uow.insertRecord(inserted); uow.commitWork(); System.assert(insertResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name='UOW Insert'].size()); Account changed = new Account(Id=insertResult.getId(),Name='UOW Updated'); Database.SaveResult updateResult = uow.updateRecord(changed); uow.commitWork(); System.assert(updateResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name='UOW Updated'].size()); Account upserted = new Account(Name='UOW Upsert'); Database.UpsertResult upsertResult = uow.upsertRecord(upserted); uow.commitWork(); System.assert(upsertResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name='UOW Upsert'].size()); Account deleted = new Account(Name='UOW Delete'); insert deleted; Database.DeleteResult deleteResult = uow.deleteRecord(deleted); uow.commitWork(); System.assert(deleteResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(0,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name='UOW Delete'].size()); List<SObject> inserts = new List<SObject>{new Account(Name='UOW Insert List')}; List<Database.SaveResult> insertResults = uow.insertRecords(inserts); uow.commitWork(); System.assert(insertResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name='UOW Insert List'].size()); Account listChanged = new Account(Id=insertResults[0].getId(),Name='UOW Updated List'); List<SObject> updateRecords = new List<SObject>{listChanged}; List<Database.SaveResult> updateResults = uow.updateRecords(updateRecords); uow.commitWork(); System.assert(updateResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name='UOW Updated List'].size()); Account listUpserted = new Account(Name='UOW Upsert List'); List<SObject> upsertRecords = new List<SObject>{listUpserted}; List<Database.UpsertResult> upsertResults = uow.upsertRecords(upsertRecords); uow.commitWork(); System.assert(upsertResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name='UOW Upsert List'].size()); Account listDeleted = new Account(Name='UOW Delete List'); insert listDeleted; List<SObject> deleteRecords = new List<SObject>{listDeleted}; List<Database.DeleteResult> deleteResults = uow.deleteRecords(deleteRecords); uow.commitWork(); System.assert(deleteResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(0,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name='UOW Delete List'].size()); Account discarded = new Account(Name='UOW Discard'); List<SObject> discardedRecords = new List<SObject>{discarded}; List<Database.SaveResult> discardedResults = uow.insertRecords(discardedRecords); uow.discardWork(); uow.commitWork(); System.assert(!discardedResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(null, discardedResults[0].getId()); System.assertEquals(0,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name='UOW Discard'].size());
